body: Forward test of the promise-tracker method (not a recommendation). Probability 0.35 that: Skipper FY27 order inflow ≥ ₹7,500 cr. Reason: FY26 inflow guide was cut and missed (5,678 vs 6,500–7,000); export promises missed by ~half. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier.
title: Paper call: Skipper FY27 order inflow ≥ ₹7,500 cr
